rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone knows about or understands something.

example.english: I only became aware now that you weren't the one who did it.
example.traditional: 我而家先至清楚件事唔係你做嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 sin1 zi3 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 nei5 zou6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when aware means awake or clear-headed, rather than for knowing information.

example.english: I only became aware again after I woke up from being drunk.
example.traditional: 我飲醉咗，瞓醒先至清醒返。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jam2 zeoi3 zo2 fan3 seng2 sin1 zi3 cing1 sing2 faan1

rows.note: Use this when someone is vigilant or on guard against danger.

example.english: You need to be more aware when walking on deserted roads at night.
example.traditional: 夜晚行偏僻路要警覺啲。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 haang4 pin1 pik1 lou6 jiu3 ging2 gok3 di1
